cards.text: Compare these supplier quotes in a table: total for what I need, what's included, delivery cost and time, minimum order, payment terms. Write "not stated" where a quote doesn't say. Then list the catches and one question to ask each supplier. I need: [QUANTITY]. Quotes: [PASTE TEXT OF EACH]

slides.note: Remove account numbers and your own contact details first.

messages.text:
I need 1,000 takeaway cups.
A) 1,000 cups $180. Delivery $25, 5 days. Pay within 30 days.
B) $160 per 1,000. Minimum order 2,000. Free delivery. Pay upfront.
C) 1,000 compostable cups $210 incl. delivery, 3 days. Lids not included.

• B only looks cheapest: the 2,000 minimum doubles what you pay now.
• C has no lids and no payment terms.
Ask:
• A: is delivery free above a certain order?
• B: will you do 1,000 at this price?
• C: what do lids cost, and when do I pay?

slides.title:
Lowest on paper: B.
Lowest cost **today**: A.

caption:
How to compare supplier quotes with AI in a clean table

Every quote hides delivery, minimums and payment terms in a different spot. This prompt lines them up and points out the catches.

Copy this:

"Compare these supplier quotes in a table: total for what I need, what's included, delivery cost and time, minimum order, payment terms. Write 'not stated' where a quote doesn't say. Then list the catches and one question to ask each supplier. I need: [QUANTITY]. Quotes: [PASTE TEXT OF EACH]"

On 3 sample quotes for takeaway cups, the one with the lowest unit price turned out to need a 2,000-cup minimum, and the compostable option didn't include lids.

Two rules: remove account numbers before pasting, and check the totals with a calculator. AI can slip on numbers.
